## Summary
A brief one-line description of the feature or algorithm you would like added.

## Algorithm / Feature Details
- **Name:** (e.g. BLAKE3, CRYSTALS-Dilithium v3.1, Argon2)
- **Category:** (e.g. Hash Functions, PQC, Stream Ciphers)
- **Standard / Reference:** (e.g. RFC 9106, NIST FIPS 205, IETF Draft)
- **Python library (if applicable):** (e.g. `pyblake2`, `pycryptodome`)

## Motivation
Why is this algorithm/feature valuable to include? What educational or research purpose does it serve?

## Implementation Notes
Any notes on how this could be implemented, edge cases, or known challenges.

## Additional Context
Links to papers, RFCs, reference implementations, or test vectors.
